title: Mixed Event — Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World — Episode3 For This One Moment

meta.Event: Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World
meta.Event Outline: One day at the archery club, by a strange coincidence, Shizuku senses something hidden beneath Mafuyu's smile. It reminds her of the time when they met for the first time and...

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line:
Wow! Again, no misses!
You're a total pro now, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I have you and the others to thank.
Hehe. I never realized how good it'd feel when your arrow goes where you want it to.

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I think all of us remember the first time we hit the target.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Asahina's so incredible...
That means I also need to...!)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
Oh, you dropped your arrow.
Don't worry. That happened to me a lot when I was first starting out.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
Try relaxing a bit.
It tends to happen when you grip your draw hand a little too tightly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My draw hand... That's my right hand... Relax a bit and...

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line:
Me too!
It's my first ever!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Oh...
The other first years are starting to show signs of improvement...)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: Hehe. It's normal to feel a little anxious with the newcomer tournament coming up and all, but it's okay. These things happen when you're just starting to learn.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: I know you're also busy as an idol, Hinomori, so let's just take it one step at a time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup! So, a lot happened and I put in my papers yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
B-But why...?!
As far as I could tell, things have been going very well for you recently.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It was nice to hear that our viewers liked seeing me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's not the kind of success I was looking for... As a result, I got into a big argument with my manager and the agency CEO...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do you mean? Not the kind of success you were looking for...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, don't worry about that. I should be fine from here on out...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I put a lot of thought into it and decided that I need to change agencies in order to succeed in the way I actually want. So, again, I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I still have some questions, but you have my support, Airi. I agree that you should do as your heart says...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, it is sad to see you leave our agency...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That makes us rivals now. Watch out cause I'm not pulling any punches!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right...
Let's both do our best.

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line: You're the only one who still hasn't put on their outfit, right? Is everything okay? You seem preoccupied.

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
Well, if you say so...
The show's about to start, so I need to get going...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I made the decision to do my best as an idol, at school and at club.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I've been having so much trouble that I've needed to rely on others just to get by...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And worst of all... I couldn't see what Airi was going through...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For the sake of our fans, I need to be perfect. I have to do my absolute best...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I've learned to actually shoot arrows, but I'm yet to hit the target...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (At this rate, I won't be able to do anything meaningful during the newcomer tournament...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The other girls from my year are showing clear signs of improvement, while I...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's only natural for a skill gap to develop since I can't attend every day...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I'm also having trouble as an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Nothing has been going well despite how hard I've been trying... I couldn't even help Airi...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I know it was recommended to me, but continuing with archery isn't a good idea...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (In this state, I'm only going to become a burden to the other club members.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hello.
Were you practicing by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-Yes.
Are you here to do the same...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, since we have that tournament coming up. I've been coming to practice in the morning for about a month now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, Hinomori, I'm impressed by how you've been balancing being both an idol and a member of this club.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, you give me too much credit...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've yet to hit the target even once, so I'd like to learn how to at least hit it before the tournament...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's exactly why I'm so impressed by you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're doing your very best to overcome the obstacle that's in front of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But Asahina's been practicing when no one else is around...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're such an incredible person, Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're such a good archer and a wonderful person... I am trying my best like you said, but I'm struggling to produce results.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Because of that...
I've been causing everyone around me so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why...? Why can't I be more perfect like you, Asahina...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Far from it. That's why I'm here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Taking up archery made me realize something. This place... It calms me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I believe this is a place where you have no choice but to clear your mind of all other thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If your mind wanders at all... If you're not fully focused on your arrow... It won't hit the target.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, I set everything aside when I'm here... School, my friends, all of it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Focusing only on shooting has this way of calming me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you'll be able to move forward if you learn to do that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I've been so focused on “being perfect” that I let it get to me.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I need to simplify things...
I need to temporarily set all of my worries aside...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Then, I might just be able to move forward...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you like to join me, Hinomori? We can try attaining that calmness together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Let's try together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(First, establish your stance.
Correct your posture...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Nock your arrow. Grasp the string. Maintain your posture. Raise your bow and arms...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Take a deep breath.
And focus on just that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This shot is all you care about right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Right. I can't let anything else into my head...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(You don't need to be perfect.
Just focus. Calm yourself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This shot is all that matters right now. Focus only on that...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-It hit...!
Asahina, my arrow hit...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you learn to repeat that, I'm sure you'll do just fine during the newcomer tournament.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Asahina.
I'm... I'm overcome with joy...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was so worried that nothing would go right for me... I really didn't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. You're a hardworking person, Hinomori, so I suspected that you were overthinking things a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Whenever that happens, it can feel like the walls are closing in on you, and you hate everything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: However, I think you'll be fine now that you've learned to calm your mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you'll be able to push much further ahead now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Again, Asahina, thank you very much!
